name: lispan_geo_v5
description: Network v5 (geometry): the v4 recipe (hard charge inventory, 0.08-3 C, v2 chemistry box) with the cathode thickness (20-200 um) and SPAN scale factor f (1-5, porosity 0.87-0.37) as two more inputs, the separator fixed to a 25 um polyolefin membrane, the transport domain Theta = I L / porosity^1.5 <= 0.03 A/m and loading <= 6 mg S/cm2 (src/dfn_pinn/lispan/geo_pinn.py, docs/GEOMETRY.md).  Design and window: configs/lispan_geo_design_v5.json (scripts/lispan_geo_design.py).  ~1.3-1.5 s per step in the sandbox: 300 000 steps ~110-125 h on one Grace core (--time=168:00:00, partition long) or a GPU.
